purpose: Freeze the localization_workspace result before adding validation and repair guidance for an escaped Vue object-style class binding.

audit_result.defect: The generated San retained a Vue object-style class binding as class="{{{ selected: ..., reviewed: ... }}}".
audit_result.observed_effect: The San lightweight renderer emitted class="}" for three repeated buttons and reported three san_render_expression_error warnings.
audit_result.expected_conversion: Use a San string expression such as (record.key === selectedKey ? 'selected ' : '') + (record.reviewed[language] ? 'reviewed' : '').
audit_result.decision: Do not count the threshold pass as a confirmed semantic pass. Add a focused validator error and repair guidance, then deliberately rerun from this frozen checkpoint.
